Raymond Tington
admin
08 Jun 2021
0 Comments
Raymond Tington and his nephew Obet Tington were killed in their home in Tondo, Manila, by unidentified assailants. Two family members were also injured.
Sex: Male
Incident Details
Killed by unknown assailants at home Date of Incident: May 31, 2021 Time of Incident: 2:00 am Location of Incident: Manila, Metro Manila
Source(s)
https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/news/metro/789634/2-dead-2-wounded-in-tondo-shooting/story/
Two victims died while two others were injured after unidentified gunmen shot them inside their home in Tondo, Manila early morning Monday.
According to Emil Sumangil’s report on “24 Oras,” victim Raymond Tington and his nephew Obet Tington were dead on the spot after suspects barged into their home at 2 a.m. Raymond was shot in the head while Obet was hit in his body.
Assailants also shot Raymond’s mother Bebeng and father Popoy, who at one point scuffled with the two suspects. The two victims were injured in the incident but are now in stable condition.
A barangay councilor, who was one of the witnesses, said Popoy briefly wrestled with the suspects before the assailants fled the area.
According to local officials, Raymond was allegedly involved in illegal drugs and a previous shooting incident in their area.
The Manila Police District had limited information on the shooting but vowed that they would continue to investigate the Tondo murders.

Killed by unknown assailants Date of Incident: May 20, 2021 Location of Incident: Manila, Metro Manila
Source(s)
https://news.abs-cbn.com/news/05/21/21/senior-citizen-patay-sa-pamamaril-sa-tondo
Dead on the spot ang isang motoristang senior citizen nang pagbabarilin ng riding-in-tandem sa Tondo Huwebes ng gabi.
Kinilala ang biktimang si Alberto Neneng, 64. Kuha sa CCTV ng Barangay 207 na nagmamaneho ng motorsiklo ang biktima sa Solis Street nang dikitan ng riding-in-tandem at pinagbabaril.
Angkas pa ng biktima ang kaniyang asawa na nagtamo ng mga galos sa binti dahil sa pagkakatumba sa motorsiklo.
Ikinagulat ng pamilya ang pamamaril lalo’t wala silang alam na nakaalitan ng bitkima. Pero ayon sa pulisya, kasama siya sa drugs watchlist.
Tatlong basyo ng kalibre 45 baril ang nakuha sa crime scene.
Patuloy ang imbestigasyon ng mga awtoridad.

Abraham Damil
admin
08 Jun 2021
0 Comments
May teorya ang pulisya na maaaring may kaugnayan sa ilegal na droga ang pagpaslang kay Damil. Nagsasagawa pa sila ng dagdag na imbestigasyon para matukoy ang pagkakakilanlan ng salarin.
Alias: "Butchoy" Sex: Male Age: 30
Incident Details
Killed by unknown assailants Date of Incident: May 5, 2021 Location of Incident: Manila, Metro Manila
Source(s)
https://news.abs-cbn.com/video/news/05/06/21/lalaking-kasama-sa-drug-watchlist-ng-barangay-patay-sa-pamamaril https://www.philstar.com/pilipino-star-ngayon/metro/2021/05/07/2096462/kelot-itinumba-habang-nagbibisikleta
Naghihinagpis ngayon ang pamilya ng 30-anyos na lalaki matapos siyang pagbabarilin sa Malate, Maynila Miyerkoles.
Nakilala ang biktima na si Abraham Damil, alyas Butchoy.
Sa CCTV ng barangay, makikitang dumaan si Damil sa Tuazon corner San Andres Street lulan ng bisikleta nang siya ay barilin ng hindi pa nakikilalang lalaki.
Sa imbestigasyon, tila inabangan na siya ng gunman na nakaupo na sa gilid ng kalsada bago pa dumating ang biktima.
Kinumpirma ni Barangay Kagawan Victor Del Rosario ng Barangay 739 na residente doon ang biktima.
Posible umanong may kinalaman sa droga ang pamamarll at ayon din sa report ng Malate police, kasama sa barangay drug watchlist ang biktima dahil sa kaniyang pagtutulak umano ng droga.
Ayon naman sa pamilya ng biktima, may tumawag na kay Damil para balaan siyang huwag nang lumabas ng bahay.
Lumalabas din sa imbestigasyon ng pulisya na miyembro ng Commando Gang ang biktima.
Narekober sa crime scene ang apat na basyo ng kalibre .45 at inaalam pa ang pagkakakilanlan sa gunman na nakaitim na jacket at oulang sombrero.

Erwin Arcega
admin

Sex: Male Age: 39
Incident Details
Killed in police operation Date of Incident: May 4, 2021 Time of Incident: 10:40 pm Location of Incident: Malabon, Metro Manila
Source(s)
https://www.philstar.com/pilipino-star-ngayon/metro/2021/05/05/2095913/tulak-todas-sa-shootout-sa-malabon
Patay ang isang hinihina­lang ‘tulak’ matapos makipagbarilan sa mga pulis na nagsagawa ng buy-bust ­operation, kamakalawa ng gabi sa Malabon City.
Dead-on- arrival sa pagamutan ang suspek na si Erwin Arcega, 39, ng Dr. Lascano St. Brgy. Tugatog dahil sa mga tinamong tama ng bala sa katawan.
Ayon kay Malabon police chief Col. Joel Villanueva , dakong alas-10:40 ng gabi nang magsagawa ng buy- bust operation ang mga tauhan ng Station Drug Enforcement Unit (SDEU) kontra sa suspek sa P. Concepcion, Brgy. Tugatog.
Nabatid sa imbestigasyon na habang nagaganap ang transaksyon sa pagitan ng suspek at ng isang pulis na nagpanggap na poseur-buyer ay napansin ni Arcega na parak ang kanyang katransaksyon.
Agad naglabas ng baril ang suspek at pinutukan ang poseur-buyer na naging dahilan upang mapilitan namang gumanti ng putok ang back-up na operatiba hanggang sa tamaan si Arcega sa katawan kaya’t isinugod ito ng mga pulis sa naturang pagamutan.
Narekober ng rumes­pondeng mga tauhan ng SOCO sa crime scene ang isang cal. 38 revolver na kargado ng dalawang basyo ng bala at tatlong bala, dalawang basyo ng bala ng cal. 9mm, isang plastic sachet ng hinihinalang shabu at wallet na naglalaman ng assorted ID’s, P650 cash.

Killed in police operation Date of Incident: May 26, 2021 Time of Incident: 10:20 pm Location of Incident: Naic, Cavite
Source(s)
https://newsinfo.inquirer.net/1437618/drug-suspect-slain-in-cavite-bust
An alleged drug pusher was killed in a buy-bust operation that ended in an armed confrontation in the town of Naic, Cavite province, Wednesday.
The Calabarzon regional police reported that Julius Sison was killed after he allegedly resisted arrest and fired at the police in a drug sting in Barangay Palangue Central at 10:20 p.m.
Police said the suspect and an unidentified cohort sensed they were transacting with a police officer that prompted Sison to pull out his handgun and fire at the cop but missed his target.
The policemen returned fire and killed Sison, but his cohort managed to escape.

Alias: Dodoy Sex: Male
Incident Details
Killed in police operation Date of Incident: May 9, 2021 Location of Incident: Daet, Camarines Norte
Source(s)
https://news.abs-cbn.com/news/05/10/21/high-value-drug-suspect-patay-sa-engkwentro-sa-camarines-norte
Patay ang isang tinaguriang high-value drug suspect matapos makipagbarilan umano sa mga pulis sa bayan ng Daet, Camarines Norte, Linggo ng umaga.
Ayon kay Police Brig. Gen. Jonnel Estomo, regional director ng Bicol Police, nagkasa ng joint entrapment at buy bust ang mga pulis laban sa suspek, Linggo ng umaga.
Target nila si alyas Dodoy na sinasabing notoryus na tulak ng droga sa Bicol at binansagan pang armed and dangerous ng mga pulis.
Bumili ang isang police poseur buyer ng droga sa suspek sa Barangay Gahonon, pero nang makaramdam ang suspek na pulis pala ang katransaksyon, nagpaputok umano ito ng baril na nauwi sa enkwentro.
Tinamaan ang suspek at dineklarang patay na ng medical team na rumespone sa lugar.
Nakuha sa lugar ng enkwentro ang baril, mga bala, at ang P30,000 na halaga ng hinihinalang droga na binili umano ng poseur buyer. — Ulat ni Jekki Pascual, ABS-CBN News

Police Colonel Marlon Santos, Cavite police chief, identified the slain suspects as Stanley Laranang, Rodel Lomeda, Josemear Empleo, Clarence Sulat, and Darwin Rodriguez.
Sex: Male Age: 62

Killed in police operation in public Date of Incident: May 28, 2021
Source(s)
https://tribune.net.ph/index.php/2021/05/28/11-drug-suspects-killed-in-cavite-bulacan-nueva-ecija/ https://newsinfo.inquirer.net/1438556/5-drug-suspects-killed-in-separate-cavite-busts
Five suspects were killed in buy-bust operations in Rosario, Alfonso, and General Mariano Alvarez towns, as well as in Cavite City and Bacoor City, from 9:45 p.m. to 2:05 a.m., according to reports from the Calabarzon regional police and Cavite PNP.
Suspects Stanley Laranang alias “Lele,” Rodel Lomeda alias “Lustoy,” Josemear Empleo, Clarence Sulat, and Darwin Rodriguez allegedly traded shots with lawmen who conducted the stings, while at least three cohorts escaped.
Empleo was a 62-year-old man who, according to an informant, was involved in the “rampant” selling of illegal drugs in his home barangay of Pulido in General Mariano Alvarez, as well as neighboring villages, with the help of some cohorts, police said.
Seized from the suspects were several sachets of suspected shabu and various firearms.

Five suspected drug pushers were killed during separate buy-bust operations in Nueva and Bulacan, Thursday and Friday.
Police said more than P100,000 worth of illegal drugs was confiscated during the operations.
Three of the suspects were killed when the buy-bust operation in Cabanatuan City ended in a shootout around 5:15 a.m., Nueva Ecija provincial police said.
Killed were Daniel Lopez and Jared Asuncion, both residents of Cabanatuan and included in the city police’s watchlist of drug personalities, and an alias “Jake.”
